Plompy Local 0.13.0Source guide · 2026-11-12

Documentation/Release history

Every release.
A little more possibility.

What shipped, when it shipped, and what changed. Follow Plompy from its first published engine to local tools for your own agent.

Published versions are listed below. Development changes on main are not a release, and older notes describe the capabilities and limits of their own version.

Latest stable12 November 2026
0.13.0

Local tools for your agent, version 0.13.0

Add an authenticated local MCP gateway for independently running Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and compatible clients, without Discord or a second model account in the container.

What’s new in 0.13.0 ↗Download Local starter kit ↓Run locally ↗

Published versions

16 releases
  1. 0.13.012 November 2026Latest

    Local tools for your agent ↗, version 0.13.0

    Add an authenticated local MCP gateway for independently running Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and compatible clients, without Discord or a second model account in the container.

  2. 0.12.011 November 2026

    Plompy Engine ↗, version 0.12.0

    Rebrand the project, repository links, packages, CLI, configuration examples and container to plompy-engine.

  3. 0.11.110 November 2026

    Unattended Playwright ↗, version 0.11.1

    Add an explicit --tool-approval approve option for the built-in Codex Playwright integration, enabling unattended browser actions without changing global approval settings. Keep the default and --yes…

  4. 0.11.010 November 2026

    Browser, research and analytics tools ↗, version 0.11.0

    Add Playwright, Perplexity, Firecrawl, TinyFish and PostHog to the guided integrations menu for Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode, with maintained task instructions and explicit authentication modes.

  5. 0.10.010 November 2026

    Node 26 LTS ↗, version 0.10.0

    Require official Node 26 LTS, at least 26.13.0, and SQLite 3.54.0 or newer. Migrate the pinned container, CI, host instructions and developer version files together. Node 24 is no longer supported by this…

  6. 0.9.010 November 2026

    Install, inspect, verify ↗, version 0.9.0

    Add guided private setup for Codex and the experimental host adapters, hidden token input, explicit token-file/stdin automation and shell-quoted mode-0600 configuration. Preserve existing resources and…

  7. 0.8.19 November 2026

    Safe goal recovery under queue pressure ↗, version 0.8.1

    Keep the shared 30-job queue bound when resuming a safely paused supervised goal. A full queue leaves its saved candidate, control state and remaining budget unchanged; retry !goal resume after capacity is…

  8. 0.8.09 November 2026

    Evidence for every reviewed step ↗, version 0.8.0

    Bind a code repository to a supervised goal with --repo <absolute path>. Capture its working-tree contents before and after each worker step, so commits and staging cannot hide code or test changes from the…

  9. 0.7.07 November 2026

    Supervised goals ↗, version 0.7.0

    Add !goal and its !loop alias for bounded Codex work reviewed after each step by a fresh supervisor session. Keep the worker's session, save candidates before review, and share one execution budget between…

  10. 0.6.16 November 2026

    Release 0.6.1 ↗, version 0.6.1

    Add !queue with current-thread task IDs, accepted order and waiting reasons. Share runner and predecessor predicates with the scheduler; keep other conversations and task content private. Inspection does…

  11. 0.6.06 November 2026

    Integrations and recovery without losing the thread ↗, version 0.6.0

    Choose Codex, Claude Code or OpenCode before configuring integrations, with explicit --runner targeting and private managed MCP defaults for the host adapters. OpenCode model providers, including Go, use…

  12. 0.5.05 November 2026

    Private Discord image input ↗, version 0.5.0

    Accept still PNG, JPEG and WebP attachments with a caption, without text, or with an explicit !work goal in Codex threads. Pass local files as native Codex image inputs on both initial and resumed turns.

  13. 0.4.05 November 2026

    Provider-bound runners and offline demos ↗, version 0.4.0

    Add experimental Claude Code and OpenCode host runners alongside the default Codex CLI, with explicit deployment-level selection for new threads.

  14. 0.3.15 November 2026

    Recovery and clock-safe workflows ↗, version 0.3.1

    Retry scoped memory commits after a transient Git failure without leaving staged content behind. Preserve operator staging; tracked deletions and renames remain supported.

  15. 0.3.04 November 2026

    Durable bounded work sessions ↗, version 0.3.0

    Add explicit !work 30m <goal> and !work 2h <goal> sessions with a fixed owner goal, active execution budget and 32-step cap.

  16. 0.2.04 November 2026

    Release 0.2.0 ↗, version 0.2.0

    Add a non-root Docker runtime with separate private state, workspace, and Codex authentication volumes.

A record of what shipped

Changes come from the engine changelog. Publication dates, download assets and the latest-stable label come from GitHub releases. Development-only entries stay out of this list.
